## Activity

During April 2022, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 336 captures. This records the total activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the subsequent review of image quality and grading outcomes. The activity was recorded at the clinic as part of its routine site operations.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 16 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.8 per cent. This measure indicates the proportion of captures that could not proceed to grading because the image quality was insufficient for assessment. No further image-quality issues are recorded in the site report.

## Grading

Grading identified 87 referable results. The median wait from photograph capture to grading was 20 days. These figures summarise the grading outcome and the interval associated with the reported activity during April 2022.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month. Overall, the report records the clinic’s capture volume, the number and rate of ungradable images, the referable grading results, and the median grading lag for the month.
